import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan and controller objects
scan = application.Scan
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² area
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # 0.1 seconds per line
scan.Lines = 32  # 32 lines per frame

# Set PID gains
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
# Note: DGain might not be available in all systems, will try to set if possible

# Verify parameters
print("Scan parameters configured:")
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"P Gain: {zcontrol.PGain}")
print(f"I Gain: {zcontrol.IGain}")

del spm
"}

import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()

scan = application.Scan

print("Starting Scan 1...")
print(f"Scan parameters: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Lines} lines, {scan.Scantime}s per line")

    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(1)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scan 1 completed!")

del spm
"}
